PATTERNS TO REMEMBER

A divided continent

NORTH

Mostly Protestant

Lutheranism became strong in Scandinavia and many northern German states.

SOUTH

Mostly Catholic

Spain, Portugal, the Italian states, and Austria remained Roman Catholic.

CENTER

A patchwork

The German states and Swiss Confederation mixed Catholic, Lutheran, and Reformed areas.

BORDERS

Conflict zones

France and the Netherlands show why mixed regions often experienced intense conflict.
